 Now Reading Your Horoscope This Week: October 25 To 31
 Story from Horoscopes ADVERTISEMENT Your Horoscope This Week: October 25 To 31
 Dossé-Via Trenou Last Updated October 25, 2026 , 11:00 AM 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Cosmic beings, the final week of October is astrologically charged, with our first full week of Scorpio Season unfolding alongside our first full week of Venus retrograde in Libra . That combination of water and air asks us to honor the intensity of what we feel while also recognizing what is no longer ours to keep carrying. Relationships, financial stress, beauty, self-esteem, and the way we measure our own worth can all come under review. Scorpio wants emotional truth, while Libra wants balance, so this week may reveal where holding on has become heavier than simply letting go.  On October 26th, the Taurus Full Moon brings some much-needed earth energy into the mix and turns our attention toward the practical ways our lives need to change. Taurus is fixed energy, so there may be something we already know we have outgrown but still feel reluctant to release because it is familiar, comfortable, or once made us feel secure. This Full Moon can make that evolution impossible to ignore. And because it is ruled by Venus retrograde in Libra , the release does not have to be dramatic. There is something powerful about peaceful detachment here: accepting that something had value in one chapter of your life without forcing it to remain valuable forever.  Advertisement The second half of the week is about coming down from the Full Moon and simplifying. As the Taurus Moon begins to wane, spend less energy chasing answers and more time grounding yourself in what is already tangible: your body, your environment, the people who consistently show up, and the small pleasures that make life feel full. We end October being asked to define value beyond a number in a bank account or someone else’s approval. What feels stable? What feels nourishing? What is actually worth your energy now? Those answers can tell you a lot about what you are ready to carry into November.  Read your horoscopes for your Sun and Rising signs for the most in-depth forecast. DashDividers_1_500x100 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Aries Sun & Rising: 
 Aries, this first full week of Scorpio Season may feel like shedding a skin you didn’t  realize had become too tight. This is one of the more profound seasons of the year for you because it pulls your attention toward emotional, spiritual, and psychological transformation rather than outward momentum. You may feel more private, more intense, or more aware of the parts of yourself that are ready to evolve. Let the retrogrades slow the process down. You don’t need to force clarity or rush into the  “new you” before you have fully released the version of yourself you’re outgrowing. Some transformations work best when they are allowed to be messy, quiet, and deeply honest.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th illuminates your money, security, and self worth sector. This could bring a financial windfall, an unexpected expense, or simply a sobering realization about the way you relate to money and stability. Whatever comes up, Taurus energy prefers a steady game plan over an impulsive reaction, especially with Venus retrograde right now. Review what’s working, release what’s draining you,  and get honest about what you actually need in order to feel secure both financially and emotionally. The end of October wants you grounded in what’s real, not rushing toward what is next.  Advertisement 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Taurus Sun & Rising: 
 Taurus, this first full week of Scorpio Season may make relationships feel a lot more  consuming than usual. You could find yourself excavating every layer of a connection,  reading more deeply into someone’s behavior, or feeling more possessive, protective, or even slightly obsessive about where you stand with people who matter to you. Scorpio energy can make intimacy feel all-or-nothing, and because it sits opposite your sign, it may pull you out of your usual comfort zone by asking you to confront the emotional undercurrents you would normally rather stabilize than dissect. Let yourself notice what is being revealed without turning every feeling into a final conclusion.  Then your annual Taurus Full Moon arrives on October 26th and brings the focus decisively back to you. A milestone from the past six months may become clear, or you may reach an emotional breaking point that ends up being the breakthrough you needed. This lunation asks you to come back to your body, your needs, your pace, and your own sense of self — the relationship that ultimately sets the tone for every other one. Let yourself feel whatever comes up without immediately trying to move past it, then use that clarity to create a steadier inner and outer foundation so you can end October feeling more rooted in who you are. 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Gemini Sun & Rising: 
 Gemini, this first full week of Scorpio Season asks you to go deeper than the surface level version of wellness. Green smoothies, strength training, and a perfectly organized routine can only take you so far if your mind is exhausted or your inner dialogue is constantly tearing you down. Scorpio energy pushes you to look more honestly at the psychological habits underneath your daily life: the way you speak to yourself, the stress you normalize, and the parts of you that are still performing “fine” when something clearly needs attention. This is a powerful week to shed habits and mindsets that no longer match the person you are becoming, and to replace self criticism with a much more compassionate form of discipline.  Advertisement Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th lands in your spirituality, solitude, and subconscious sector, which may pull you slightly out of your comfort zone. You’re usually happiest when there’s movement, conversation, and something new to think about, but this lunation asks you to slow down enough to face what has been lingering underneath the noise. Old memories, insecurities, or people from the past may resurface, and the release could be surprisingly physical or emotional. Turn your notifications off, spend more time alone, meditate, journal, sit under a tree, hug one if you feel like it… anything that helps you come back into your body and out of mental overdrive. If you give yourself that space, you could end October feeling dramatically lighter and much more ready to soar into November.  Cancer Sun & Rising: 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang Cancer, this first full week of Scorpio Season can feel like your heart is turning the volume up on everything that makes you feel alive. Romance, creativity, pleasure, and inner-child healing all come into sharper focus, but Scorpio asks you to go beyond surface-level fun and notice where desire is tangled up with fear, control, or old emotional conditioning. You may feel more passionate, more magnetic, or more creatively obsessed, but also more aware of what still makes you hesitate to fully enjoy yourself. Let this week show you where joy has been carrying emotional baggage, and give yourself permission to want what you want without immediately interrogating it.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th lights up your friendship, community, and future-goals sector, helping you see which people and plans actually feel stable enough to grow with you. A friendship, collaboration, or long-term goal may reach a milestone, or you may realize that a certain social dynamic has run its course. Taurus energy helps you come back to what’s consistent and trustworthy rather than what’s simply exciting in the moment. By the end of the month, you may feel much clearer about who belongs in your next chapter and which dreams are worth building slowly. Advertisement 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Leo Sun & Rising: 
 Leo, this first full week of Scorpio Season turns your attention toward home, family,  and the emotional foundation underneath everything else. You may feel more protective  of your space, more sensitive to old family dynamics, or more aware of where you have been carrying tension privately while still showing up confidently in public. Scorpio energy can excavate memories, loyalties, and emotional patterns that shaped you long before you had language for them. The goal this week isn’t to fix your entire past; it’s to understand what still has influence over you and decide what deserves to come with you into your next chapter.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th lights up your career, reputation, and public-image sector, bringing a culmination around something you’ve been building over the past six months. Recognition, a professional milestone, a decision about your direction, or even a realization that a certain version of success no longer satisfies you could come to the surface. Taurus asks you to move from pressure into sustainability, so pay attention to what feels solid rather than what simply looks impressive. By month’s end, the balance between your private life and public ambitions may feel much clearer, and that clarity can help you build a version of success that actually feels good to live inside of.  
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Virgo Sun & Rising:
 Virgo, this first full week of Scorpio Season asks you to pay much closer attention to the stories running through your mind all day. Your communication, thinking, learning, and immediate environment are activated, but Scorpio wants more than surface-level  observations. You may become aware of a thought pattern you repeat when you feel insecure, a conversation you keep replaying, or a truth you have been editing because saying it plainly felt too vulnerable. This week is powerful for deeper mental cleanup:  questioning assumptions, naming what you actually feel, and shedding ways of thinking that keep you hyper-vigilant rather than genuinely prepared.  Advertisement Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th illuminates your expansion, travel, education, publishing, and belief sector, helping you zoom out after so much inner analysis. A goal you’ve been working toward over the past six months may reach a milestone, or you may feel ready to make a more grounded decision about where you want to go next. Taurus energy encourages you to trust the path that feels steady and sustainable rather than chasing movement for movement’s sake. By the end of the month, you may realize that your perspective has changed enough to make a whole  new future feel possible. 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Libra Sun & Rising:
 Libra, this first full week of Scorpio Season pulls you into a deeper conversation with money, self-worth, and the kind of security you actually trust. You may become more aware of where you spend to self-soothe, where you undervalue your time, or where your sense of worth still rises and falls depending on someone else’s approval. Scorpio energy wants you to get underneath the number in the bank account and look at the emotional story attached to it. This is a powerful week to shed scarcity habits,  comparison, or financial choices that no longer reflect who you are becoming, especially with Venus retrograde encouraging you to reassess what feels truly valuable.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th illuminates your intimacy, shared resources, and transformation sector, bringing a deeper relationship or financial matter to a turning point. A debt, agreement, emotional bond, or trust issue may reach some kind of culmination, and the lesson is to stay grounded enough to see what is actually sustainable. Taurus wants clear terms, steadiness, and reciprocity, so this Full Moon may help you recognize where you are overextended or where support is finally becoming available. By the end of October, you may feel much clearer about what you are willing to share, what you need to protect, and what kind of merging actually feels safe.  Advertisement 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Scorpio Sun & Rising: 
 Scorpio, this first full week of your birthday season can feel like your energy is finally returning to you. After weeks of retrograde reflection, emotional excavation, and questioning what you still want, the sun in your sign gives you permission to take up more space again. You may feel more magnetic, more certain of your instincts, and more willing to move toward the version of your life that feels deeply yours. This is a powerful reset point for identity, confidence, appearance, desire, and personal direction. Let yourself celebrate how much you have already shed. You are entering a  new solar chapter with more self-knowledge than you had a year ago, and that alone  changes the way you move through everything next.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th illuminates your partnership sector and may reveal who’s actually equipped to soar with you into this next chapter. A relationship, friendship, collaboration, or commitment could reach an important milestone, while another may make it painfully obvious that loyalty has been keeping you attached past the expiration date. Scorpio can be loyal to a fault once someone has earned a place in your heart, but this Full Moon asks whether the connection is still reciprocal, grounded, and capable of growing with you. Let people reveal who they are. The right ones will not require you to shrink your evolution in order to keep them close.  
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Sagittarius Sun & Rising: 
 Sag, this first full week of Scorpio Season may feel quieter than your usual rhythm, but there is a lot happening beneath the surface. Your solitude, subconscious, and healing zone is activated, so you may crave more privacy, more sleep, or simply more distance from people and situations that keep you mentally overstimulated. Scorpio Season can bring old emotions, fears, or unfinished chapters back into awareness, but the point is not to get lost in them. It is to understand what is draining your energy and what you are finally ready to release before your own season begins next month.  Advertisement Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th lights up your work, wellness, and daily routine sector, helping you turn that inner awareness into something practical. A habit, responsibility, health matter, or work situation may reach a culmination, or you may realize your body has been trying to tell you something for a while. Taurus energy wants consistency over extremes, so resist the urge to overhaul your entire life overnight. One steady change to your schedule, boundaries, or self-care could do more for you than another burst of motivation that disappears by next week.  
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Capricorn Sun & Rising: 
 Capricorn, this first full week of Scorpio Season puts your attention on the people,  communities, and future plans that actually have enough substance to grow with you. You may feel more selective socially, more protective of your long-term vision, or more aware of which friendships inspire you versus which ones leave you depleted. Scorpio Season can deepen your sense of loyalty, but it can also make you question whether certain alliances are rooted in genuine support or simply history. This is a strong week to get serious about the kind of network you want around the life you are building next.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th lights up your romance, creativity, pleasure, and inner-child sector, bringing a much more personal kind of culmination. A love story, creative project, passion, or desire may reach an important milestone, and you may suddenly see how much joy you have been postponing in the name of responsibility. Taurus wants something you can actually feel and enjoy, so let this Full Moon reconnect you with what makes life worth all the effort. By the end of October, you may realize that pleasure deserves a permanent place in your plans, not just whatever time is left over.  Advertisement 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Aquarius Sun & Rising: 
 Aquarius, this first full week of Scorpio Season puts real weight behind your ambitions and the way you want to be known. Your career, reputation, and public image are activated, but Scorpio energy makes this more than a simple productivity push. You may feel more strategic, more selective about what you attach your name to, and more aware of where you have been chasing visibility without enough emotional investment behind it. This is a strong week to deepen your commitment to the work that actually matters to you and to move with intention rather than trying to prove yourself everywhere at once.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th pulls you back toward home, family, and your emotional foundation. A living situation, family matter, or private emotional need may reach a turning point, and you could suddenly realize that external success feels very different when your inner world is unsettled. Taurus energy asks you to stabilize from the inside out. Give yourself permission to slow down, protect your space, and define what security looks like beyond achievement. That grounding can help you end  October feeling much more centered about where you are going next. 
 Illustrated by Wenjing Yang. Pisces Sun & Rising: 
 Pisces, this first full week of Scorpio Season can make you hungry for meaning in a way that feels almost impossible to ignore. Your expansion, travel, education, publishing, spirituality, and belief sector is activated, so you may find yourself questioning whether the life you’re living is still big enough for the person you are becoming. Scorpio adds emotional depth to those questions, which can make a certain dream, destination, field of study, or spiritual path feel more urgent than usual. Follow what keeps pulling at you, but let the retrograde atmosphere keep you reflective enough to understand why it matters before you make any sweeping decisions.  Then the Taurus Full Moon on October 26th lights up your communication, learning, and immediate-environment sector, helping you bring all of that bigger-picture thinking  back down to earth. A conversation, writing project, sibling dynamic, decision, or piece of news may reach a turning point and give language to something you have been sensing for weeks. Taurus wants clarity that can actually be used, so simplify what feels overly complicated and say what you mean. By the end of October, you may feel  much more grounded in your own voice and clearer about which ideas are worth carrying forward.  Advertisement
